verdict.rationale: Codex supports API-key based usage and MCP integration (codex-gh-4, codex-docs-16, codex-docs-21), but there's no evidence of a dedicated official SDK for building on Codex, and community reports confirm the latest Codex model isn't even available via API yet ('gpt-5.3-codex isn't available on the API yet' — codex-comm-5). Docs probes for platform.openai.com also 404 (codex-probe-1, codex-probe-2), suggesting weak first-class SDK/API documentation.
